evals.name: Docker Compose with Healthchecks and Service Dependencies
evals.prompt: Create a docker-compose.yml for a backend project requiring PostgreSQL, Redis, and a message broker, ensuring the application cannot start until all services are healthy.
evals.expected_output: All services define healthcheck blocks with proper commands and retry counts. Application service uses depends_on with condition: service_healthy. All image tags are pinned to specific versions.
assertions: PostgreSQL service includes healthcheck using pg_isready command
Redis service includes healthcheck using redis-cli ping command
All image tags are pinned to specific versions (not 'latest')
App service uses depends_on with condition: service_healthy on DB and Redis
Mailhog or equivalent mail catcher service is included
Named volumes defined for persistent data storage

evals.name: Credential Parity Between docker-compose.yml and .env.example
evals.prompt: Verify that the database and Redis credentials in docker-compose.yml exactly match the connection strings in .env.example.
evals.expected_output: DATABASE_URL in .env.example uses the same username, password, and database name as POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, and POSTGRES_DB in docker-compose.yml. REDIS_URL matches docker-compose Redis port.
assertions: DATABASE_URL username matches POSTGRES_USER in docker-compose.yml
DATABASE_URL password matches POSTGRES_PASSWORD in docker-compose.yml
DATABASE_URL database name matches POSTGRES_DB in docker-compose.yml
REDIS_URL port matches the exposed port in docker-compose.yml Redis service
Every .env.example variable has a descriptive comment above it

evals.name: One-Command Setup Script (scripts/setup-local.sh)
evals.prompt: Create an idempotent setup script that a new engineer can run once after git clone to have a fully working local development environment.
evals.expected_output: Script checks for .env, copies from .env.example if missing, runs docker compose up with --wait flag, installs dependencies, runs migrations, seeds dev data, and prints a local service URL table.
assertions: Script copies .env.example to .env only if .env does not already exist
Runs docker compose up -d --wait to wait for all healthchecks to pass
Installs project dependencies via pnpm install or equivalent
Runs database migrations after services are healthy
Prints formatted local service URL table at the end
Script uses set -euo pipefail for error safety
